scenes.heading: Building group programs or courses alongside 1:1 work

sents.d: Building group programs or courses alongside 1:1 work
Group and self-paced offers can extend your income beyond one-on-one hours.

One-on-one coaching and consulting time is inherently limited by your calendar — group programs (multiple clients going through the same process together) and self-paced courses let you serve more people without a linear increase in your own hours.

A group program built from your existing signature framework requires relatively little new content creation, since the core material already exists from your 1:1 work — the main new skill is facilitating group dynamics rather than 1:1 conversations.

Many practitioners find a hybrid model works best: 1:1 work for clients who want individualized attention and can pay a premium for it, alongside a lower-priced group or course option for those who want the content but not the individualized time.

take: Add a group program built from your existing framework.
